decompressed_mirror_audit.status: Candidate objects matched to original archive source or exclusion records by project, path, and byte size; separate mirror supplement checked by S3 metadata
decompressed_mirror_audit.method: List object metadata without downloading mirrored file bodies. Environment, account, cache, and internal shared subtrees are excluded. Original per-project source and exclusion manifests will be used to check coverage.
decompressed_mirror_audit.cache_exclusion_rule: Unpacked mirror paths containing .hf_cache are model and dataset cache copies, excluded from the research release; their individual object metadata remains in release-source-mirrors.csv.gz.
